reputation.name: Rating
reputation.meaning: What customers think of you, from 0 to 5 stars
reputation.why: Higher rating brings more customers every day

group.name: Party
group.meaning: A set of customers who arrive and sit together
group.why: Each party needs a table, a server and a bill

walk_out.name: Walk-out
walk_out.meaning: A party that left because they waited too long
walk_out.why: You lose the sale and your rating drops

patience.name: Patience
patience.meaning: How long a party will wait before leaving

86.name: Sold out / Off the menu
86.meaning: A dish you cannot or will not serve today
86.why: Customers who wanted it are disappointed

rota.name: Days off
rota.meaning: Each person's weekly day off; the restaurant itself never closes
rota.why: Put days off on quiet days and keep key roles apart

stand_in.name: Stand-in
stand_in.meaning: Someone doing another role's work on that person's day off
stand_in.why: Slower and less skilled than the real thing

negotiation.name: Negotiated prices
negotiation.meaning: Lower supplier prices won by a skilled manager
negotiation.why: Cuts your biggest cost; lost if that manager leaves

deputy.name: Deputy
deputy.meaning: A staff member your manager has trained to run a branch
deputy.why: A ready-made manager for your next outlet

area.name: Where you stand
area.meaning: The part of the restaurant you are working in
area.why: You do the jobs there and your staff there work faster

favour.name: Favour
favour.meaning: One of three special efforts you can call on in a shift
favour.why: They come back slowly, so choose where they count

rush.name: Rush
rush.meaning: Telling the kitchen to cook one table's order first
rush.why: Saves a table that is about to walk out

treat.name: Treat
treat.meaning: Something free for customers who are waiting
treat.why: They wait longer, for a small cost

bring_the_bill.name: Bring the bill
bring_the_bill.why: Frees the table for the queue, but they feel hurried

shift_target.name: Target
shift_target.meaning: The most parties you can afford to lose this shift
shift_target.why: Tells you whether the night went well

owner_energy.name: Your energy
owner_energy.why: Exhausted owners make mistakes and lose a day

morale.name: Happiness
morale.meaning: How happy a staff member is at work, from 0 to 100
morale.why: Unhappy staff are slower, call in sick and may quit without warning

notice.name: Notice
notice.meaning: Days a leaving staff member still works
notice.why: Without notice you are short-handed tomorrow

fatigue.name: Tiredness
fatigue.meaning: How worn out a staff member is
fatigue.why: Tired staff are slow and get hurt

reliability.name: Reliability
reliability.meaning: How often they turn up on time

batch_daysleft.name: Use-by
batch_daysleft.meaning: How many days until this stock goes bad
batch_daysleft.why: Expired stock is thrown away — money in the bin

waste.name: Waste
waste.why: Waste comes straight out of profit

par_level.name: Keep-in-stock level
par_level.meaning: The amount you always want on the shelf
par_level.why: The game reorders up to this level for you

food_cost.name: Food cost
food_cost.meaning: Share of a dish's price spent on ingredients
food_cost.why: Above about 35% the dish earns too little

margin.name: Profit per dish
margin.meaning: What is left from the price after ingredients
margin.why: Popular dishes with thin profit can still lose money

station_slot.name: Cooking station
station_slot.meaning: A place where one kind of dish is cooked
station_slot.why: A broken station removes its dishes from the menu

condition.name: Condition
condition.meaning: How worn a machine is, 0 to 100
condition.why: Worn machines break down at the worst time

maintenance.name: Servicing
maintenance.meaning: A small paid check-up of a machine

hygiene.name: Cleanliness
hygiene.meaning: How clean the restaurant is, 0 to 100
hygiene.why: Low cleanliness fails inspections and sickens guests

operating_profit.name: Profit
operating_profit.meaning: Money in minus the cost of running the place
operating_profit.why: This is what pays back your loan

cash_flow.name: Cash in hand
cash_flow.meaning: Money you can spend right now
cash_flow.why: You can be profitable and still unable to pay wages

instalment.name: Loan payment
instalment.meaning: The weekly amount you repay the bank
instalment.why: Missing three in a row ends the game

credit_score.name: Bank trust
credit_score.meaning: How much the bank trusts you
credit_score.why: Decides how much you can borrow and at what cost

valuation.name: Company value
valuation.meaning: What your whole business is worth
valuation.why: Unlocks the final stage and is your score

due_diligence.name: Inspect before buying
due_diligence.meaning: Paying to look for hidden problems
due_diligence.why: Shows trouble before it becomes yours

hidden_problem.name: Inherited problem
hidden_problem.meaning: Trouble the last owner left behind
hidden_problem.why: Shows up in your first weeks

incident.name: Situation
incident.meaning: Something has happened and needs your decision
incident.why: Ignoring it lets the worst option happen

request.name: Request
request.meaning: Your manager asking permission for something beyond their limit

contribution.name: Contribution
contribution.meaning: What a branch added to or took from company money this week
contribution.why: Shows which branches carry the others

payback.name: Paid back
payback.meaning: How much of what you spent on a branch it has earned back
payback.why: Tells you whether opening it was worth it

transfer.name: Transfer
transfer.meaning: Moving a staff member to another branch
transfer.why: Strengthens one branch and weakens another

break_even.name: Break-even
break_even.meaning: The number of parties you must serve in a day to cover that day's costs
break_even.why: Below it the day loses money even if the room looked busy

fixed_costs.name: Costs that never stop
fixed_costs.meaning: Rent, wages and loan payments you owe whether customers come or not
fixed_costs.why: A slow week still costs the same

manager_grade.name: Grade
manager_grade.meaning: A manager's overall level, from Trainee to Veteran
manager_grade.why: Higher grades need less of your time and cost more

potential.name: Potential
potential.meaning: How good a manager can become with experience and coaching
potential.why: A cheap manager with high potential is worth investing in

manager_skills.name: People / Upkeep / Stock
manager_skills.meaning: How well a manager handles staff, equipment and ordering
manager_skills.why: Weak skills show up as waste, breakdowns and resignations

campaign_outcome.name: How the ad went
campaign_outcome.meaning: Whether a campaign flopped, did as expected or hit big
campaign_outcome.why: Ads are a gamble; the right audience and a fresh menu improve the odds

return_on_spend.name: Return
return_on_spend.meaning: Extra profit a campaign brought back for each coin spent on it
return_on_spend.why: Below ×1 the ad lost money; compare channels to see what works here

buzz.name: Buzz
buzz.meaning: How much people are talking about your restaurant
buzz.why: It fades unless you advertise or do something new

freshness.name: Menu freshness
freshness.meaning: How new your menu feels to regulars
freshness.why: A menu that never changes slowly loses customers

competition.name: Rivals
competition.meaning: Other restaurants competing for your customers
competition.why: Success attracts them; staying the same lets them win

equipment_age.name: Age
equipment_age.why: Old machines break more even when serviced

badge.name: Badge
badge.meaning: Proof that an outlet has paid for itself and runs without you
badge.why: Gold badges unlock a bonus for the whole chain

format.name: Type of outlet
format.meaning: The kind of place it is: office, mall, tourist spot…
format.why: Each type has its own challenge and adds something new

secured_loan.name: Loan against an outlet
secured_loan.meaning: A cheaper loan the bank can recover by taking the outlet's sale money
secured_loan.why: If you sell that outlet the loan is paid off first

affordability.name: Can you afford it
affordability.meaning: The bank compares your weekly repayments with your weekly profit
affordability.why: Low profit means the bank says no, however much you need it

counter_offer.name: Bank's offer
counter_offer.meaning: A smaller loan than you asked for
counter_offer.why: Take it, or improve your numbers and ask again

private_lender.name: Private lender
private_lender.meaning: Someone who lends without questions at very high interest
private_lender.why: A last resort that can sink you

sale_estimate.name: What it would sell for
sale_estimate.meaning: The likely price for an outlet today
sale_estimate.why: It falls when profit and rating fall

lease.name: Lease
lease.meaning: Your contract to rent the premises for a set number of years
lease.why: Longer is cheaper but costly to leave early

break_fee.name: Leaving fee
break_fee.meaning: What you pay to end a lease early
break_fee.why: Makes closing a bad outlet expensive

fit_out.name: Fit-out
fit_out.meaning: Building work to turn empty premises into a restaurant
fit_out.why: Rent is due while it is being done

equipment_lease.name: Rented equipment
equipment_lease.meaning: A machine you pay for weekly and never own
equipment_lease.why: No big payment and free repairs, but it costs more over time

goodwill.name: Goodwill
goodwill.meaning: What you pay for a running restaurant's customers and name
goodwill.why: Why buying costs more than building

policy.name: Standing orders
policy.meaning: Rules your manager follows when you are away
policy.why: Good orders keep a branch running without you

neglect_slack.name: Standards slipping
neglect_slack.meaning: What happens when you do not visit a branch
neglect_slack.why: Service slows, waste and theft rise

skimming.name: Missing cash
skimming.meaning: Sales and cash in the till do not match

crisis.name: In trouble
crisis.meaning: A branch that has lost money four weeks running
crisis.why: Fix it or close it before it sinks the company

auto_run.name: Fast-forward
auto_run.why: Possible only when every job is filled
